verses.1: Adam knew his wife Eve, and she had a son named Cain. She said, "I have gotten a man with the LORD's help."
verses.2: Later she had another son named Abel. Abel took care of sheep, and Cain worked the ground and grew food.
verses.3: After some time, Cain brought some of his crops as an offering to the LORD.
verses.4: Abel also brought an offering — the best of the firstborn from his flock. The LORD was pleased with Abel and his offering,
verses.5: but He was not pleased with Cain and his offering. Cain became very angry and his face showed it.
verses.6: The LORD said to Cain, "Why are you angry? Why do you look so upset?
verses.7: If you do what is right, will you not be accepted? But if you do not do what is right, sin is waiting at the door, ready to control you. But you must not let it."
verses.8: Cain said something to his brother Abel. Then when they were out in the field together, Cain attacked his brother Abel and killed him.
verses.9: The LORD said to Cain, "Where is your brother Abel?" Cain said, "I do not know. Am I supposed to look after my brother?"
verses.10: The LORD said, "What have you done? Your brother's blood is crying out to Me from the ground.
verses.11: Now you are cursed from the ground that opened up to receive your brother's blood from your hands.
verses.12: When you try to grow food, the ground will not give you what it used to. You will wander from place to place with no home."
verses.13: Cain said to the LORD, "This punishment is too hard for me to bear.
verses.14: You are driving me away from the land and away from Your presence. I will be a wanderer with no home, and anyone who finds me will kill me."
verses.15: The LORD said to him, "No. If anyone kills Cain, he will be punished seven times over." And the LORD put a mark on Cain so that no one who found him would hurt him.
verses.16: Then Cain left the presence of the LORD and went to live in a land called Nod, east of Eden.
verses.17: Cain and his wife had a son named Enoch. Cain also built a city and named it Enoch after his son.
verses.18: Enoch had a son named Irad. Irad was the father of Mehujael, Mehujael was the father of Methushael, and Methushael was the father of Lamech.
verses.19: Lamech married two women. One was named Adah and the other was named Zillah.
verses.20: Adah had a son named Jabal. He was the first person to live in tents and raise livestock.
verses.21: His brother was named Jubal. He was the first person to play the harp and flute.
verses.22: Zillah had a son named Tubal-cain. He was the first to make tools from bronze and iron. Tubal-cain had a sister named Naamah.
verses.23: Lamech said to his wives, "Adah and Zillah, listen to me. I have killed a man who hurt me, a young man who struck me.
verses.24: If Cain would be paid back seven times for being harmed, then I will be paid back seventy-seven times."
verses.25: Adam and Eve had another son. Eve named him Seth and said, "God has given me another child to take the place of Abel, whom Cain killed."
verses.26: Seth also had a son and named him Enosh. It was during this time that people began to call on the name of the LORD.

metadata.source: Based on the Authorized King James Version (1769), reinterpreted through the theology of abiding in Christ.
